modified_caption: The bar chart presents CoLeG-R (%) performance metrics for the LLaMA-2 model family under sequential supervised fine-tuning (SFT) conditions. The horizontal axis categorizes three model scales: LLAMA-2-7B, LLAMA-2-13B, and LLAMA-2-70B, while the vertical axis quantifies CoLeG-R (%) from 0 to 80 in 10% increments. Each model category features four bars representing distinct SFT conditions: no SFT (blue, diagonal stripes), SFT on D₀ (yellow, horizontal stripes), SFT on D₀ and D₁ (purple, slanted stripes), and SFT on D₀, D₁, and D₂ (peach, solid fill). For LLAMA-2-7B, performance stabilizes at approximately 66% without SFT, then sharply escalates to 85% with SFT on D₀ and D₁, before slightly declining to 82% with full SFT. The LLAMA-2-13B model demonstrates a more gradual improvement, starting at 70% without SFT, rising modestly to 72% with SFT on D₀, and consistently exceeding 80% with additional SFT datasets, though it fails to surpass the 7B variant under equivalent conditions. The LLAMA-2-70B model exhibits superior baseline performance at 80%, with incremental gains peaking at 83% after SFT on D₀ and D₁, but unexpectedly underperforms relative to the 13B model when fully fine-tuned. These results suggest that while scaling model size broadly enhances CoLeG-R, the benefits of extensive SFT diminish for larger models, particularly when comparing the 13B and 70B variants.

modifications.claim: For LLAMA-2-7B, performance sharply escalates to 85% with SFT on D₀ and D₁.
modifications.reality: The LLAMA-2-7B model reaches approximately 80% with SFT on D₀ and D₁, not 85%. The value is exaggerated by 5 percentage points, making the improvement seem more dramatic than it is.

modifications.claim: The LLAMA-2-13B model consistently exceeds 80% with additional SFT datasets, though it fails to surpass the 7B variant under equivalent conditions.
modifications.reality: The LLAMA-2-13B model does not consistently outperform the 7B variant under equivalent SFT conditions. In fact, the 13B model's performance with SFT on D₀, D₁, and D₂ (peach bar) is roughly equal to or slightly lower than the 7B model's performance in the same condition.

modifications.claim: The LLAMA-2-70B model unexpectedly underperforms relative to the 13B model when fully fine-tuned.
modifications.reality: The LLAMA-2-70B model does not underperform relative to the 13B model when fully fine-tuned. Both models achieve similar CoLeG-R percentages (~80%) in the fully fine-tuned condition, with the 70B model slightly outperforming the 13B model.

original_caption: CoLeG-E (left) and CoLeg-R (right) of scaling up SFT dataset across various model scales in the LLaMA-2 family. The results suggest scaling up model scales and SFT dataset can further improve CoLeG.
